statement: Keep the 19 mechanically flagged rows pending future review. The boundary row d0ffd52881d0b074 does not exceed the corrected 448-token limit and is not in the corrected rate-outlier set, so it is OUTSIDE the Option B listening scope. This is NOT a quality endorsement of that row.

out_of_scope.why: raw 449 tokens minus the one stripped start-of-transcript token is exactly 448 -- the decoder limit, not above it. The bos_token_id defect inflated every row by one token and this row sat on the boundary. It is also absent from the corrected rate-outlier set.
out_of_scope.explicitly_not: a quality endorsement. The row is untested and unlistened-to, exactly like every other row in the corpus that was never flagged.

draft_state.note: The draft is NOT edited by this decision. It still lists the original 20 entries and all remain unclassified. This record narrows what a future reviewer must listen to; it does not classify anything, and no row has been listened to.

relationship_to_policy: DQ-2026-003 defers 19 rows from the Option B run by policy. That deferral and this scope decision are different things: one excludes rows from a training run, the other says which rows a human must eventually hear. Neither is a data-quality finding.
content_policy: checksums and counts only; no transcript, audio or speaker data
